main_body: A bonsai-style pine tree with a leaning brown trunk and three flat-topped green canopy pads (upper, right and left-lower)
top_band: Canopy pads show lighter green on top (rows ~1-8) over darker green undersides; the trunk is a vertical organic form with no distinct top surface
evidence: This is an organic tree, and the contract is only loosely applicable to it. The canopy pads read as volumes: light-green upper surfaces with mid-green bodies and dark-green undersides that act as an eave shadow. The trunk is a plain vertical form, as a tree trunk should be. No receding isometric side face is drawn. Although the canopy tops are not crisp horizontal bands, the pads clearly show a lit top and a shaded front, so the piece reads as a 3/4 organic object.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 4 green steps with some clumpy dither, and the dark-green outline is tinted to match the leaves, while the trunk has a dark brown outline beside the wood. This is the right approach. Compared with the references, which use 5-6 greens with leaf-cluster highlights and a rooted base with many tones, the candidate is thinner. The canopy interiors are fairly smooth, the trunk has only 3-4 browns with limited grain, and the grass base is sparse. It is cleanly drawn but lacks the richness of the references, so it would look slightly thinner beside them.
